provider: Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA), National Flood Insurance Program / OpenFEMA
api_version: OpenFEMA NFIP Residential Penetration Rates v1; official catalogue last data refresh 2026-08-04

request_contract.parameter_rules: Provider documents GET and OData-like $top, $skip, $filter and $select. Its current v1 endpoint is fixed; an earlier separate Neon research receipt #41 records an exact GET with $top=2 on 2026-11-12, not a newly executed probe. This documentation-only contract does NOT permit a new network request, paging, unrestricted field selection, bulk acquisition or transmission of results. A future reviewed fixed read-only request must bind parameters, UTC timestamp, response size, content type, exact original-body SHA-256, release identity and 429 policy before activation. No user-supplied host, URL, headers or unbounded query.

response_contract.format: OpenFEMA v1 JSON records with a provider metadata object and NfipResidentialPenetrationRates records; no original response was fetched under this access contract.
response_contract.scientific_semantics: US county/community-level estimated residential NFIP contracts-in-force divided by estimated residential structure stock from NSI 2022, with separate SFHA and all-area ratios. Official refresh 2026-08-04 and three-month update frequency are metadata, not a frozen data version. Private flood policies are excluded. Some rates exceed 100% owing to incomplete NSI building stock; do not clip or treat them as a valid probability. Provider row id may change on refresh, so use FIPS plus asOfDate and retrieval identity for subsequent joins. Not actual insured exposure, building TIV, observed flood hazard, damage or a loss model; NSI-linked evaluations are not an independent holdout.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: Official OpenFEMA guidance states a general limit of 200 requests per 5 minutes per IP and no more than two concurrent requests, with HTTP 429 on exceedance. NFIP claims and policies have stricter limits, but this penetration-rates endpoint is a distinct product. No request authorized or executed by this documented_only contract; a future bounded probe needs separate review.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: Version 1 remains a mutable quarterly-updated dataset (official last refresh 2026-08-04 when reviewed 2026-11-14). The provider says row id is not stable between refreshes, and incomplete NSI 2022 denominators can yield over-100% penetration. Retain source/endpoint, asOfDate, FIPS, exact request and original response SHA and bytes before any comparable empirical claim.

rights_and_policy.notes: Official OpenFEMA Terms and Conditions last updated 2025-01-22 govern both API and file downloads. They state use is solely for statistical research or reporting; prohibit reidentification and individual eligibility decisions; require citation of exact version and access time and a no-FEMA-endorsement notice; reserve the right to request cessation and deletion. The 'secondary use' paragraph does not explicitly clear commercial CAT production, insurer underwriting, derived model redistribution or indefinite retention. Public US federal provenance is not blanket third-party dataset rights. Statistical research scope may be assessable after specific permission/rights review, but commercial insurer automation, raw/derived redistribution and production modelling remain unapproved. No new download and no personal/provider data published in Git.
